newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Zivno AGM approves CZK160 '96 gross dividend.
newsitem.headline: Czech Zivno AGM approves CZK160 '96 gross dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Prague-based Zivnostenka Banka a.s. approved on Monday a gross dividend for 1996 of 160 crowns, the same as in the previous year.

"In 1996 we did not attain our goal of increasing net profit, of which the absolute amount fell seven percent against 1995. That reduction wasn't as such that it would influence the payment of a 16 percent (of nominal value) dividend," Zivnobanka general director Jiri Kunert told the bank's annual general meeting.
Dividends are to be paid to shareholders registered as holding Zivnobanka stock on Monday, June 2, and should be paid out within three months, the AGM agreed.
The bank had already posted net profit for 1996 of 375 million crowns against 406 million crowns in 1995.
